summary: Material Week 2 update: Cleveland placed Dylan Sampson on IR, leaving Quinshon Judkins as the clear starter with Raheim Sanders behind him. Covers' bet365 board, last updated 2026-09-15 22:38 ET, shows Judkins over 12.5 rushing attempts at -105. FantasyPros projects 16.9 attempts and CBS projects 17.0. PRIME classifies O12.5 -105 as BET_NOW only if the same bet365 number/price remains live; play-to 13.5 at -115, with mandatory reprice at 14.5+. Receiving yards remains a lean/watch, not an add-on, to avoid same-thesis overexposure.

decisions.injuryNewsDependencies: Dylan Sampson placed on IR on 2026-09-15. Judkins currently has no injury designation. Recheck Wednesday practice/injury report and live price before placement.
decisions.rationale: Judkins handled 67% of Cleveland's Week 1 rushing attempts in a game where the Browns ran only 49 regulation plays and trailed heavily. Sampson is now on IR, reducing backfield competition. Judkins averaged 16.4 carries per game in 2025 and cleared 12.5 attempts in 9 of 14 2025 games; including Week 1 2026, he cleared 12.5 in 9 of his last 15 starts. Independent Week 2 projections are 16.9 (FantasyPros) and 17.0 (CBS). The negative game-script risk as a road underdog is already reflected in the conservative internal mean/fair probability. The wager is price-specific and should not be chased above 13.5 without recalculation.
